# Bluedroid bond-preservation objects

`esp32s3-idf4-bond-objects.zip` contains three rebuilt ESP-IDF objects, not a
replacement of the entire SDK. Original copyright notices and Apache-2.0
license are in `tools/bluedroid_bond_patch/upstream/`.

Source: Espressif ESP-IDF commit `e499576efdb086551abe309a72899302f82077b7`.
MeshCore modifications are generated by `tools/bluedroid_bond_patch/generate.py`.
Build and object-comparison instructions are in `tools/bluedroid_bond_build/`.
`scripts/bluedroid_bond_manifest.json` binds these objects to the exact stock
SDK archive. Builds reconstruct a private archive and verify its final hash
and linked object paths; installed PlatformIO SDK files are never modified.

The fix keeps the existing Bluedroid NVS format. It does not migrate NimBLE
bonds, make replacement writes power-loss atomic, or change the SDK's normal
successful-pairing eviction policy when its bond store is full.
